args.summary: Fixed the case-sensitivity bug in astropy.io.ascii.qdp. The line-type classifier in _line_type compiled its QDP command/data regex case-sensitively, so lowercase commands like `read serr 1 2` raised ValueError: Unrecognized QDP line. Two changes in astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py: (1) compiled the line-type regex with re.IGNORECASE so QDP commands (READ SERR/READ TERR, NO data tokens, NAN) are matched case-insensitively, consistent with the QDP spec; (2) changed the per-value `v == "NO"` check in _get_tables_from_qdp_file to `v.upper() == "NO"` so lowercase `no` in data rows is treated as masked. The existing `err_specs[command[1].lower()]` already handled command-word case. Added regression test test_lowercase_commands to astropy/io/ascii/tests/test_qdp.py covering the task's exact reproduction (lowercase `read serr 1 2` file reads into a Table with error columns col1/col1_err/col2/col2_err, plus a lowercase `no` value becoming masked) and a direct _line_type unit check for lowercase and mixed-case commands. Verified: the original repro now succeeds, all 9 tests in test_qdp.py pass, the qdp.py doctests pass, and the full astropy/io/ascii suite (826 passed, 36 skipped, 6 xfailed) passes.
